# Spec: SQL in 40 hours

OBJECTIVE: the learner writes correct analytical SQL on a real dataset without help, in 40 core hours.
SCALE: M        LEARNER: analyst, spreadsheets daily, no SQL
GOAL: pass a 2-hour take-home on a public dataset at a hiring bar
BASE RATE: assumption, stated: most self-taught learners need 30-60 hours to write joins and window functions unaided; replaced by a sourced figure in Q-001
VARIETY: 10 shapes from variety.md, ranges per block; no shape twice in a row
SIGN-OFF: the user said "yes, exactly" [x]
